items.hebrew: יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ, מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה. יְיָ צְבָאוֹת, אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ. יְיָ הוֹשִׁיעָה, הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ.
items.translation: Adhonay of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. Adhonay of hosts, happy is the one who trusts in You. Adhonay, save us; may the King answer us on the day we call.
items.translit: Adhonay ṣĕvaʾoth 'immanu, misgav lanu ʾĕlohe ya'ăqov sela. Adhonay ṣĕvaʾoth, ʾashre ʾadham boṭeaḥ bakh. Adhonay hoshi'a, hammelekh ya'ănenu vĕyom qarĕʾenu.

items.hebrew: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֹן וְלֹא יַשְׁחִית, וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא יָעִיר כָּל חֲמָתוֹ. יְיָ הוֹשִׁיעָה, הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ.
items.translation: But He, being merciful, forgives iniquity and does not destroy; often He turns His anger away, and does not stir up all His wrath. Adhonay, save us; may the King answer us on the day we call.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ raḥum yĕkhapper 'awon wĕloʾ yashḥith, wĕhirba lĕhashiv ʾappo wĕloʾ ya'ir kol ḥămatho. Adhonay hoshi'a, hammelekh ya'ănenu vĕyom qarĕʾenu.

items.hebrew: החזן אומר
items.translation: The leader says:

items.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ אֶת יְיָ הַמְּבֹרָךְ.
items.translation: Bless Adhonay, the blessed One.
items.translit: barĕkhu ʾeth Adhonay hammĕvorakh.

items.hebrew: הקהל עונים
items.translation: The congregation responds:

items.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ הַמְּבֹרָךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
items.translation: Blessed is Adhonay, the blessed One, forever and ever.
items.translit: barukh Adhonay hammĕvorakh lĕ'olam wa'edh.

items.hebrew: החזן חוזר
items.translation: The leader repeats:

items.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ הַמְּבֹרָךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
items.translation: Blessed is Adhonay, the blessed One, forever and ever.
items.translit: barukh Adhonay hammĕvorakh lĕ'olam wa'edh.

items.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים בְּחָכְמָה, פּוֹתֵחַ שְׁעָרִים בִּתְבוּנָה, מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת הַזְּמַנִּים, וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת הַכּוֹכָבִים בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִיעַ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ. בּוֹרֵא יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה, גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְחֹשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי אוֹר, וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לַיְלָה, וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָיְלָה, יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים.
items.translation: Blessed are You, Adhonay our God, King of the universe, who by His word brings on evenings with wisdom, opens the gates of heaven with understanding, changes the periods of time and varies the seasons, and arranges the stars in their watches in the sky according to His will. He creates day and night, rolling away light before darkness and darkness before light; He causes the day to pass and brings on the night, and separates day from night — Adhonay of hosts is His name. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who brings on evenings.
items.translit: barukh ʾatta Adhonay ʾĕlohenu melekh ha'olam, ʾăsher bidhvaro ma'ăriv 'ăravim bĕḥokhma, potheaḥ shĕ'arim bithvuna, mĕshanneh 'ittim umaḥălif ʾeth hazzĕmannim, umĕsadder ʾeth hakkokhavim bĕmishmĕrothehem baraqia' kirṣono. boreʾ yomam walayla, golel ʾor mippĕne ḥoshekh wĕḥoshekh mippĕne ʾor, uma'ăvir yom umeviʾ layla, umavdil ben yom uven layĕla, Adhonay ṣĕvaʾoth shĕmo. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, hamma'ăriv 'ăravim.

items.hebrew: אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ אָהָבְתָּ, תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים אוֹתָנוּ לִמַּדְתָּ. עַל כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, בְּשָׁכְבֵנוּ וּבְקוּמֵנוּ נָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ, וְנִשְׂמַח וְנַעֲלוֹז בְּדִבְרֵי תַלְמוּד תּוֹרָתֶךָ וּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְחֻקּוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הֵם חַיֵּינוּ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֵינוּ, וּבָהֶם נֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה. וְאַהֲבָתְךָ לֹא תָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אוֹהֵב אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: With everlasting love You have loved the house of Israel, Your people; You have taught us Torah and mitzvot, statutes and laws. Therefore, Adhonay our God, when we lie down and when we rise we will speak of Your statutes, and rejoice and delight in the words of the study of Your Torah, Your mitzvot and Your statutes, forever; for they are our life and the length of our days, and on them we will meditate day and night. May Your love never depart from us. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who loves His people Israel.
items.translit: ʾahăvath 'olam beth yisraʾel 'ammĕkha ʾahavĕta, tora umiṣwoth ḥuqqim umishpaṭim ʾothanu limmadhta. 'al ken Adhonay ʾĕlohenu, bĕshakhĕvenu uvĕqumenu nasiaḥ bĕḥuqqekha, wĕnismaḥ wĕna'ăloz bĕdhivre thalmudh torathekha umiṣwothekha wĕḥuqqothekha lĕ'olam wa'edh, ki hem ḥayyenu wĕʾorekh yamenu, uvahem nehgeh yomam walayla. wĕʾahăvathĕkha loʾ thasur mimmennu lĕ'olamim. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ʾohev ʾeth 'ammo yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד.
items.translation: Hear, O Israel: Adhonay is our God, Adhonay is One.
items.translit: shĕma' yisraʾel Adhonay ʾĕlohenu Adhonay ʾeḥadh.

items.hebrew: [בלחש] בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
items.translation: [In a whisper:] Blessed is the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.
items.translit: [vlḥsh] barukh shem kĕvodh malkhutho lĕ'olam wa'edh.

items.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְיָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל מְאֹדֶךָ. וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל לְבָבֶךָ. וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ. וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ. וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ.
items.translation: You shall love Adhonay your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might. These words that I command you today shall be upon your heart. Teach them diligently to your children, and speak of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on the road, when you lie down, and when you rise. Bind them as a sign on your hand, and let them be as frontlets between your eyes. Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
items.translit: wĕʾahavta ʾeth Adhonay ʾĕlohekha bĕkhol lĕvavĕkha uvĕkhol nafshĕkha uvĕkhol mĕʾodhekha. wĕhayu haddĕvarim haʾelleh ʾăsher ʾanokhi mĕṣawwĕkha hayyom 'al lĕvavekha. wĕshinnantam lĕvanekha wĕdhibbarta bam bĕshivtĕkha bĕvethekha uvĕlekhtĕkha vadderekh uvĕshakhĕbĕkha uvĕqumekha. uqĕshartam lĕʾoth 'al yadhekha wĕhayu lĕṭoṭafoth ben 'enekha. ukhĕthavtam 'al mĕzuzoth bethekha uvish'arekha.

items.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם, לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁכֶם. וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ, יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ, וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ. וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ, וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ. הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן יִפְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם, וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם. וְחָרָה אַף יְיָ בָּכֶם וְעָצַר אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת יְבוּלָהּ, וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר יְיָ נֹתֵן לָכֶם. וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה עַל לְבַבְכֶם וְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם, וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם אֹתָם לְאוֹת עַל יֶדְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם. וְלִמַּדְתֶּם אֹתָם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם, בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ. וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ. לְמַעַן יִרְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְיָ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם, כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ.
items.translation: And if you diligently obey My commandments that I command you today, to love Adhonay your God and serve Him with all your heart and all your soul, I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early and the late rain, and you will gather your grain, your wine, and your oil. And I will give grass in your field for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied. Take care that your heart is not lured away to serve other gods and bow to them, for then Adhonay's anger will burn against you, and He will shut up the heavens so there is no rain and the ground will not yield its produce, and you will quickly perish from the good land that Adhonay is giving you. Set these words of Mine upon your heart and soul, bind them as a sign on your hand, and let them be frontlets between your eyes. Teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on the road, when you lie down, and when you rise. Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates — so that your days and your children's days may be many on the land that Adhonay swore to your ancestors to give them, as long as the heavens are above the earth.
items.translit: wĕhaya ʾīm shamoa' tishmĕ'u ʾel miṣwothay ʾăsher ʾanokhi mĕṣawweh ʾethkhem hayyom, lĕʾahăva ʾeth Adhonay ʾĕlohekhem ulĕ'avĕdho bĕkhol lĕvavkhem uvĕkhol nafshĕkhem. wĕnathatti mĕṭar ʾarṣĕkhem bĕ'itto, yoreh umalqosh, wĕʾasafta dhĕghanekha wĕthiroshĕkha wĕyiṣharekha. wĕnathatti 'esev bĕsadhĕkha livhemtekha, wĕʾakhalta wĕsava'ĕta. hishshamĕru lakhem pen yifteh lĕvavkhem, wĕsartem wa'ăvadhtem ʾĕlohim ʾăḥerim wĕhishtaḥăwithem lahem. wĕḥara ʾaf Adhonay bakhem wĕ'aṣar ʾeth hashshamayīm wĕloʾ yihyeh maṭar wĕhaʾădhama loʾ thitten ʾeth yĕvulah, waʾăvadhtem mĕhera me'al haʾareṣ haṭṭova ʾăsher Adhonay nothen lakhem. wĕsamtem ʾeth dĕvaray ʾelleh 'al lĕvavkhem wĕ'al nafshĕkhem, uqĕshartem ʾotham lĕʾoth 'al yedhkhem wĕhayu lĕṭoṭafoth ben 'enekhem. wĕlimmadhtem ʾotham ʾeth bĕnekhem lĕdhabber bam, bĕshivtĕkha bĕvethekha uvĕlekhtĕkha vadderekh uvĕshakhĕbĕkha uvĕqumekha. ukhĕthavtam 'al mĕzuzoth bethekha uvish'arekha. lĕma'an yirbu yĕmekhem wime vĕnekhem 'al haʾădhama ʾăsher nishba' Adhonay laʾăvothekhem latheth lahem, kime hashshamayīm 'al haʾareṣ.

items.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְיָ אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר. דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם, וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם, וְנָתְנוּ עַל צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת. וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת, וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת כָּל מִצְוֹת יְיָ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם, וְלֹא תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם. לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת כָּל מִצְוֹתָי, וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם. אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים, אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם.
items.translation: Adhonay said to Moses: Speak to the children of Israel and tell them to make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments, throughout their generations, and to put on the fringe of each corner a thread of blue. It shall be a fringe for you to look at and remember all the commandments of Adhonay and do them, and not follow after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you go astray — so that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy to your God. I am Adhonay your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God; I am Adhonay your God.
items.translit: wayyoʾmer Adhonay ʾel mosheh leʾmor. dabber ʾel bĕne yisraʾel wĕʾamarta ʾălehem, wĕ'asu lahem ṣiṣīth 'al kanfe vighdhehem lĕdhorotham, wĕnathĕnu 'al ṣiṣīth hakkanaf pĕthil tĕkheleth. wĕhaya lakhem lĕṣiṣīth, urĕʾithem ʾotho uzĕkhartem ʾeth kol miṣwoth Adhonay wa'ăsithem ʾotham, wĕloʾ thathuru ʾaḥăre lĕvavkhem wĕʾaḥăre 'enekhem ʾăsher ʾattem zonim ʾaḥărehem. lĕma'an tizkĕru wa'ăsithem ʾeth kol miṣwothay, wihyithem qĕdhoshim leʾlohekhem. ʾăni Adhonay ʾĕlohekhem ʾăsher hoṣeʾthi ʾethkhem meʾereṣ miṣrayīm lihyoth lakhem leʾlohim, ʾăni Adhonay ʾĕlohekhem.

items.hebrew: החזן חוזר
items.translation: The leader repeats: "Adhonay your God" — true.

items.hebrew: אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה כָּל זֹאת וְקַיָּם עָלֵינוּ, כִּי הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵין זוּלָתוֹ, וַאֲנַחְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ. הַפּוֹדֵנוּ מִיַּד מְלָכִים, הַגֹּאֲלֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ מִכַּף כָּל עָרִיצִים, הָאֵל הַנִּפְרָע לָנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ, הַמְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְכָל אוֹיְבֵי נַפְשֵׁנוּ. הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים, וְלֹא נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ, הַמַּדְרִיכֵנוּ עַל בָּמוֹת אוֹיְבֵינוּ, וַיָּרֶם קַרְנֵנוּ עַל כָּל שׂוֹנְאֵינוּ. הָאֵל הָעֹשֶׂה לָנוּ נְקָמָה בְּפַרְעֹה, בְּאוֹתוֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִים בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי חָם. הַמַּכֶּה בְעֶבְרָתוֹ כָּל בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם, וַיּוֹצִיא אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם לְחֵרוּת עוֹלָם. הַמַּעֲבִיר בָּנָיו בֵּין גִּזְרֵי יַם סוּף, וְאֶת רוֹדְפֵיהֶם וְאֶת שׂוֹנְאֵיהֶם בִּתְהוֹמוֹת טִבַּע. רָאוּ בָנִים אֶת גְּבוּרָתוֹ, שִׁבְּחוּ וְהוֹדוּ לִשְׁמוֹ, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בְרָצוֹן קִבְּלוּ עֲלֵיהֶם. מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה, וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם: מִי כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְיָ, מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ, נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא. מַלְכוּתְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ עַל הַיָּם, יַחַד כֻּלָּם הוֹדוּ וְהִמְלִיכוּ וְאָמְרוּ: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד. וְנֶאֱמַר: כִּי פָדָה יְיָ אֶת יַעֲקֹב, וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: True and certain is all this, and it stands firm for us, that He is Adhonay our God and there is none besides Him, and we are Israel His people — who redeems us from the hand of kings, our King who delivers us from the grasp of all tyrants, the God who exacts payment for us from our foes and repays all who hate our very lives. He who set our soul among the living and did not let our foot slip, who led us upon the high places of our enemies and raised our standing over all who hate us. The God who wrought vengeance for us against Pharaoh, with signs and wonders in the land of the descendants of Ham; who struck all the firstborn of Egypt in His fury and brought His people Israel out from among them to everlasting freedom; who brought His children through the divided Sea of Reeds, while their pursuers and their enemies He sank in the depths. His children saw His might; they praised and thanked His name, and willingly accepted His sovereignty upon themselves. Moses and the children of Israel answered You with song in great joy, and all of them said: "Who is like You among the mighty, Adhonay? Who is like You, majestic in holiness, awesome in praises, doing wonders?" Your children saw Your sovereignty at the sea, Your kingship, Adhonay our God; together they all gave thanks and proclaimed You King, and said: "Adhonay shall reign forever and ever." And it is said: "For Adhonay has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from a hand stronger than his own." Blessed are You, Adhonay, who redeemed Israel.
items.translit: ʾĕmeth weʾĕmuna kol zoʾth wĕqayyam 'alenu, ki huʾ Adhonay ʾĕlohenu wĕʾen zulatho, waʾănaḥnu yisraʾel 'ammo. happodhenu miyyadh mĕlakhim, haggoʾălenu malkenu mikkaf kol 'ariṣim, haʾel hannifra' lanu miṣṣarenu, hamĕshallem gĕmul lĕkhol ʾoyĕve nafshenu. hassam nafshenu baḥayyim, wĕloʾ nathan lammoṭ raghlenu, hammadhrikhenu 'al bamoth ʾoyĕvenu, wayyarem qarnenu 'al kol sonĕʾenu. haʾel ha'oseh lanu nĕqama bĕfar'oh, bĕʾothoth uvĕmofĕthim bĕʾadhmath bĕne ḥam. hammakkeh vĕ'evratho kol bĕkhore miṣrayīm, wayyoṣiʾ ʾeth 'ammo yisraʾel mittokham lĕḥeruth 'olam. hamma'ăvir banaw ben gizre yam suf, wĕʾeth rodhĕfehem wĕʾeth sonĕʾehem bithhomoth ṭibba'. raʾu vanim ʾeth gĕvuratho, shibbĕḥu wĕhodhu lishmo, umalkhutho vĕraṣon qibbĕlu 'ălehem. mosheh uvĕne yisraʾel lĕkha 'anu shira bĕsimḥa rabba, wĕʾamĕru khullam: mi khamokha baʾelīm Adhonay, mi kamokha neʾdar baqqodhesh, noraʾ thĕhilloth 'oseh feleʾ. malkhuthĕkha Adhonay ʾĕlohenu raʾu vanekha 'al hayyam, yaḥadh kullam hodhu wĕhimlikhu wĕʾamĕru: Adhonay yimlokh lĕ'olam wa'edh. wĕneʾĕmar: ki fadha Adhonay ʾeth ya'ăqov, ughĕʾalo miyyadh ḥazaq mimmennu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, gaʾal yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם, וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם. וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ, וְתַקְּנֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ מְהֵרָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵנוּ, וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ מַכַּת אוֹיֵב, דֶּבֶר, חֶרֶב, חוֹלִי, צָרָה, רָעָה, רָעָב, וְיָגוֹן, וּמַשְׁחִית, וּמַגֵּפָה. שְׁבוֹר וְהָסֵר הַשָּׂטָן מִלְּפָנֵינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵינוּ, וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנוּ, וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵנוּ וּבוֹאֵנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ וּמַצִּילֵנוּ אָתָּה מִכָּל דָּבָר רָע וּמִפַּחַד לָיְלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵר אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַד. אָמֵן.
items.translation: Cause us, our Father, to lie down in peace, and raise us up, our King, to a good life and to peace. Spread over us the shelter of Your peace; guide us with good counsel from before You, and save us swiftly for Your name's sake. Shield us, and remove from us enemy, plague, sword, illness, distress, evil, famine, sorrow, destruction, and calamity. Break and remove the accuser from before us and behind us, and hide us in the shadow of Your wings; guard our going out and our coming in, for a good life and for peace, from now and forever. For You, God, are our guardian and our deliverer from every evil thing and from the terror of the night. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who guards His people Israel forever. Amen.
items.translit: hashkivenu ʾavinu lĕshalom, wĕha'ămidhenu malkenu lĕḥayyim ṭovim ulĕshalom. ufĕros 'alenu sukkath shĕlomekha, wĕthaqqĕnenu malkenu bĕ'eṣa ṭova millĕfanekha, wĕhoshi'enu mĕhera lĕma'an shĕmekha. wĕhaghen ba'ădhenu, wĕhaser me'alenu makkath ʾoyev, dever, ḥerev, ḥoli, ṣara, ra'a, ra'av, wĕyaghon, umashḥith, umaggefa. shĕvor wĕhaser hassaṭan millĕfanenu umeʾaḥărenu, uvĕṣel kĕnafekha tastirenu, ushĕmor ṣeʾthenu uvoʾenu lĕḥayyim ṭovim ulĕshalom me'atta wĕ'adh 'olam. ki ʾel shomĕrenu umaṣṣilenu ʾatta mikkol davar ra' umippaḥadh layĕla. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shomer ʾeth 'ammo yisraʾel la'adh. ʾamen.

items.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
items.translation: My Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
items.translit: ʾădhonay sĕfathay tiftaḥ, ufi yaggidh tĕhillathekha.

items.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב. הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵּי אָבוֹת, וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה. מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם.
items.translation: Blessed are You, Adhonay, our God and God of our ancestors, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob — the great, mighty, and awesome God, God Most High, who bestows lovingkindness, who owns all things, who remembers the piety of the patriarchs and brings a redeemer to their children's children for His name's sake, in love. King, Helper, Savior, and Shield. Blessed are You, Adhonay, Shield of Abraham.
items.translit: barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, ʾĕlohe ʾavraham, ʾĕlohe yiṣḥaq, weʾlohe ya'ăqov. haʾel haggadhol haggibbor wĕhannoraʾ, ʾel 'elyon, gomel ḥăsadhim ṭovim, qoneh hakkol, wĕzokher ḥasde ʾavoth, umeviʾ ghoʾel livne vĕnehem lĕma'an shĕmo bĕʾahăva. melekh 'ozer umoshia' umaghen. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, maghen ʾavraham.

items.hebrew: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
items.translation: You are eternally mighty, my Lord; You give life to the dead, You are great in salvation.
items.translit: ʾatta ghibbor lĕ'olam ʾădhonay, mĕḥayyeh methim ʾatta, rav lĕhoshia'.

items.hebrew: בקיץ:
items.translation: In summer:

items.hebrew: מוֹרִיד הַטָּל.
items.translation: He causes the dew to fall.
items.translit: moridh haṭṭal.

items.hebrew: בחורף:
items.translation: In winter:

items.hebrew: מַשִּׁיב הָרוּחַ וּמוֹרִיד הַגָּשֶׁם.
items.translation: He causes the wind to blow and the rain to fall.
items.translit: mashshiv haruaḥ umoridh haggashem.

items.hebrew: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה. וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים.
items.translation: He sustains the living with kindness, gives life to the dead with great mercy, supports the fallen, heals the sick, sets captives free, and keeps faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who resembles You, a King who brings death and gives life and causes salvation to sprout? You are faithful to give life to the dead. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who gives life to the dead.
items.translit: mĕkhalkel ḥayyim bĕḥesedh, mĕḥayyeh methim bĕraḥămim rabbim, somekh nofĕlim, wĕrofeʾ ḥolim, umattir ʾăsurim, umĕqayyem ʾĕmunatho lishene 'afar. mi khamokha ba'al gĕvuroth umi domeh lakh, melekh memith umĕḥayyeh umaṣmiaḥ yĕshu'a. wĕneʾĕman ʾatta lĕhaḥăyoth methim. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕḥayyeh hammethim.

items.hebrew: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ.
items.translation: You are holy and Your name is holy, and holy ones praise You every day, forever. Blessed are You, Adhonay, the holy God.
items.translit: ʾatta qadhosh wĕshimkha qadhosh, uqĕdhoshim bĕkhol yom yĕhalĕlukha sela. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, haʾel haqqadhosh.

items.hebrew: אַתָּה חוֹנֵן לְאָדָם דַּעַת, וּמְלַמֵּד לֶאֱנוֹשׁ בִּינָה.
items.translation: You favor humankind with knowledge and teach mortals understanding.
items.translit: ʾatta ḥonen lĕʾadham da'ath, umĕlammedh leʾĕnosh bina.

items.label: Motzaei Shabbat / Yom Tov — Ata Chonantanu

items.hebrew: אַתָּה חוֹנַנְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מַדָּע וְהַשְׂכֵּל, אַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל וּבֵין אוֹר לְחֹשֶׁךְ וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים וּבֵין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. כְּשֵׁם שֶׁהִבְדַּלְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת וּמִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה, כָּךְ פְּדֵנוּ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ מִשָּׂטָן רָע וּמִפֶּגַע רָע וּמִכָּל גְּזֵרוֹת קָשׁוֹת וְרָעוֹת הַמִּתְרַגְּשׁוֹת לָבוֹא בָעוֹלָם.
items.translation: You have favored us, Adhonay our God, with insight and reason. You said we should distinguish between the holy and the ordinary, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, and between the seventh day and the six days of labor. Just as You have set us apart, Adhonay our God, from the nations of the lands and the families of the earth, so redeem us and save us from the evil adversary and from harm, and from all harsh and evil decrees stirring to come into the world.
items.translit: ʾatta ḥonantanu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu madda' wĕhaskel, ʾatta ʾamarta lĕhavdil ben qodhesh lĕḥol uven ʾor lĕḥoshekh uven yisraʾel la'ammim uven yom hashshĕvi'i lĕshesheth yĕme hamma'ăseh. kĕshem shehivdaltanu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu me'amme haʾăraṣoth umimmishpĕḥoth haʾădhama, kakh pĕdhenu wĕhaṣṣilenu missaṭan ra' umippegha' ra' umikkal gĕzeroth qashoth wĕra'oth hammithraggĕshoth lavoʾ va'olam.

items.hebrew: וְחָנֵּנוּ מֵאִתְּךָ חָכְמָה בִּינָה וָדָעַת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, חוֹנֵן הַדָּעַת.
items.translation: Favor us with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge from You. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who favors us with knowledge.
items.translit: wĕḥannenu meʾittĕkha ḥokhma bina wadha'ath. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ḥonen hadda'ath.

items.hebrew: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ לְתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְקָרְבֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְהַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָרוֹצֶה בִּתְשׁוּבָה.
items.translation: Bring us back, our Father, to Your Torah; draw us near, our King, to Your service; and return us in complete repentance before You. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who desires repentance.
items.translit: hăshivenu ʾavinu lĕthorathekha, wĕqarĕvenu malkenu la'ăvodhathekha, wĕhaḥăzirenu bithshuva shĕlema lĕfanekha. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, haroṣeh bithshuva.

items.hebrew: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ, מְחוֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, חַנּוּן הַמַּרְבֶּה לִסְלֹחַ.
items.translation: Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You are a good and forgiving God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, gracious One who forgives abundantly.
items.translit: sĕlaḥ lanu ʾavinu ki ḥaṭaʾnu, mĕḥol lanu malkenu ki fasha'ĕnu, ki ʾel ṭov wĕsallaḥ ʾatta. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ḥannun hammarbeh lisloaḥ.

items.hebrew: רְאֵה נָא בְעָנְיֵנוּ, וְרִיבָה רִיבֵנוּ, וּמַהֵר לְגָאֳלֵנוּ גְּאֻלָּה שְׁלֵמָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, כִּי אֵל גּוֹאֵל חָזָק אָתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גּוֹאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: Look, please, upon our affliction, plead our cause, and hasten to redeem us with a complete redemption for Your name's sake, for You are a mighty redeeming God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, Redeemer of Israel.
items.translit: rĕʾeh naʾ vĕ'onyenu, wĕriva rivenu, umaher lĕghoʾŏlenu gĕʾulla shĕlema lĕma'an shĕmekha, ki ʾel goʾel ḥazaq ʾatta. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, goʾel yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: רְפָאֵנוּ יְיָ וְנֵרָפֵא, הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה, כִּי תְהִלָּתֵנוּ אָתָּה, וְהַעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה וּמַרְפֵּא לְכָל תַּחֲלוּאֵינוּ וּלְכָל מַכְאוֹבֵינוּ וּלְכָל מַכּוֹתֵינוּ, כִּי אֵל רוֹפֵא רַחְמָן וְנֶאֱמָן אָתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, רוֹפֵא חוֹלֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: Heal us, Adhonay, and we shall be healed; save us and we shall be saved, for You are our praise. Bring complete healing to all our ailments, our pains, and our wounds, for You are a faithful and merciful healing God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who heals the sick of His people Israel.
items.translit: rĕfaʾenu Adhonay wĕnerafeʾ, hoshi'enu wĕniwwashe'a, ki thĕhillathenu ʾatta, wĕha'ăleh ʾărukha umarpeʾ lĕkhol taḥăluʾenu ulĕkhal makhʾovenu ulĕkhal makkothenu, ki ʾel rofeʾ raḥman wĕneʾĕman ʾatta. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, rofeʾ ḥole 'ammo yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: בקיץ:
items.translation: In summer:

items.hebrew: בָּרְכֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֵינוּ, וּבָרֵךְ שְׁנָתֵנוּ בְּטַלְלֵי רָצוֹן בְּרָכָה וּנְדָבָה,
items.translation: Bless us, Adhonay our God, in all the work of our hands, and bless our year with dew of favor, blessing, and generosity,
items.translit: barĕkhenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu bĕkhol ma'ăse yadhenu, uvarekh shĕnathenu bĕṭalle raṣon bĕrakha unĕdhava,

items.hebrew: בחורף:
items.translation: In winter:

items.hebrew: בָּרֵךְ עָלֵינוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת הַשָּׁנָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת כָּל מִינֵי תְבוּאָתָהּ לְטוֹבָה, וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה עַל כָּל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה, וְרַוֵּה פְּנֵי תֵבֵל וְשַׂבַּע אֶת הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ מִטּוּבָךְ, וּמַלֵּא יָדֵינוּ מִבִּרְכוֹתֶיךָ וּמֵעֹשֶׁר מַתְּנוֹת יָדֶיךָ,
items.translation: Bless for us, Adhonay our God, this year and all the varieties of its produce for good, and give dew and rain for blessing upon the whole face of the earth; water the face of the world and satisfy it from Your bounty, and fill our hands with Your blessings and the richness of Your gifts,
items.translit: barekh 'alenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu ʾeth hashshana hazzoʾth wĕʾeth kol mine thĕvuʾathah lĕṭova, wĕthen ṭal umaṭar livrakha 'al kol pĕne haʾădhama, wĕrawweh pĕne thevel wĕsabba' ʾeth ha'olam kullo miṭṭuvakh, umalleʾ yadhenu mibbirkhothekha ume'osher mattĕnoth yadhekha,

items.hebrew: וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתָהּ חַיִּים וְשָׂבָע וְשָׁלוֹם כַּשָּׁנִים הַטּוֹבוֹת לִבְרָכָה, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים.
items.translation: and let its end be life, plenty, and peace, like the good years, for blessing; for You are a good and beneficent God who blesses the years. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who blesses the years.
items.translit: uthĕhi ʾaḥărithah ḥayyim wĕsava' wĕshalom kashshanim haṭṭovoth livrakha, ki ʾel ṭov umeṭiv ʾatta umĕvarekh hashshanim. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕvarekh hashshanim.

items.hebrew: תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵנוּ, וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ, וְקַבְּצֵנוּ יַחַד מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְאַרְצֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַבֵּץ נִדְחֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: Sound the great shofar for our freedom, raise a banner to gather our exiles, and bring us together from the four corners of the earth to our land. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who gathers the scattered of His people Israel.
items.translit: tĕqa' bĕshofar gadhol lĕḥeruthenu, wĕsaʾ nes lĕqabbeṣ galuyyothenu, wĕqabbĕṣenu yaḥadh meʾarba' kanfoth haʾareṣ lĕʾarṣenu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕqabbeṣ nidhḥe 'ammo yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: הָשִׁיבָה שׁוֹפְטֵינוּ כְּבָרִאשׁוֹנָה וְיוֹעֲצֵינוּ כְּבַתְּחִלָּה, וְהָסֵר מִמֶּנּוּ יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה, וּמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדְּךָ, בְּחֶסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים, בְּצֶדֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּט. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ אוֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט.
items.translation: Restore our judges as of old, and our counselors as at first; remove from us sorrow and sighing; and reign over us, You alone, Adhonay, in kindness and mercy, in righteousness and justice. Blessed are You, Adhonay, King who loves righteousness and justice.
items.translit: hashiva shofĕṭenu kĕvariʾshona wĕyo'ăṣenu kĕvattĕḥilla, wĕhaser mimmennu yaghon waʾănaḥa, umĕlokh 'alenu mĕhera ʾatta Adhonay lĕvaddĕkha, bĕḥesedh uvĕraḥămim, bĕṣedheq uvĕmishpaṭ. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, melekh ʾohev ṣĕdhaqa umishpaṭ.

items.hebrew: לַמִּינִים וְלַמַּלְשִׁינִים אַל תְּהִי תִקְוָה, וְכָל הַזֵּדִים כְּרֶגַע יֹאבֵדוּ, וְכָל אוֹיְבֶיךָ וְכָל שׂוֹנְאֶיךָ מְהֵרָה יִכָּרֵתוּ, וּמַלְכוּת הָרִשְׁעָה מְהֵרָה תְעַקֵּר וּתְשַׁבֵּר וּתְכַלֵּם וְתַכְנִיעֵם בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹבֵר אוֹיְבִים וּמַכְנִיעַ מִינִים.
items.translation: Let there be no hope for informers and heretics, and let all the arrogant perish in an instant; may all Your enemies and all who hate You be swiftly cut off, and may You quickly uproot, break, cast down, and subdue the dominion of wickedness, speedily in our days. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who breaks enemies and subdues the arrogant.
items.translit: lamminim wĕlammalshinim ʾal tĕhi thiqwa, wĕkhol hazzedhim kĕregha' yoʾvedhu, wĕkhol ʾoyĕvekha wĕkhol sonĕʾekha mĕhera yikkarethu, umalkhuth harish'a mĕhera thĕ'aqqer uthĕshabber uthĕkhallem wĕthakhni'em bimhera vĕyamenu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shover ʾoyĕvim umakhnia' minim.

items.hebrew: עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים וְעַל הַחֲסִידִים, וְעַל שְׁאֵרִית עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית סוֹפְרֵיהֶם, וְעַל גֵּרֵי הַצֶּדֶק וְעָלֵינוּ, יֶהֱמוּ נָא רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְתֵן שָׂכָר טוֹב לְכָל הַבּוֹטְחִים בְּשִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, וְשִׂים חֶלְקֵנוּ עִמָּהֶם. וּלְעוֹלָם לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ כִּי בְךָ בָטָחְנוּ, וְעַל חַסְדְּךָ הַגָּדוֹל בֶּאֱמֶת נִשְׁעָנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מִשְׁעָן וּמִבְטָח לַצַּדִּיקִים.
items.translation: Toward the righteous and the pious, toward the remnant of Your people the house of Israel, toward the survivors of their scholars, toward the righteous converts, and toward us — let Your mercy be stirred, Adhonay our God. Give a good reward to all who truly trust in Your name, and set our portion among them; may we never be ashamed, for we have trusted in You, and have truly relied on Your great kindness. Blessed are You, Adhonay, support and trust of the righteous.
items.translit: 'al haṣṣaddiqim wĕ'al haḥăsidhim, wĕ'al shĕʾerith 'ammĕkha beth yisraʾel, wĕ'al pĕleṭath beth sofĕrehem, wĕ'al gere haṣṣedheq wĕ'alenu, yehĕmu naʾ raḥămekha Adhonay ʾĕlohenu, wĕthen sakhar ṭov lĕkhol habboṭĕḥim bĕshimkha beʾĕmeth, wĕsim ḥelqenu 'immahem. ulĕ'olam loʾ nevosh ki vĕkha vaṭaḥĕnu, wĕ'al ḥasdĕkha haggadhol beʾĕmeth nish'annu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mish'an umivṭaḥ laṣṣaddiqim.

items.hebrew: תִּשְׁכּוֹן בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִירְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ, וְכִסֵּא דָוִד עַבְדְּךָ מְהֵרָה בְּתוֹכָהּ תָּכִין, וּבְנֵה אוֹתָהּ בִּנְיַן עוֹלָם בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם.
items.translation: Dwell within Jerusalem Your city as You have spoken; establish there, soon, the throne of David Your servant; and build it as an everlasting structure, speedily in our days. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who builds Jerusalem.
items.translit: tishkon bĕthokh yĕrushalayim 'irĕkha kaʾăsher dibbarta, wĕkhisseʾ dhawīdh 'avdĕkha mĕhera bĕthokhah takhin, uvĕneh ʾothah binyan 'olam bimhera vĕyamenu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, boneh yĕrushalayim.

items.hebrew: אֶת צֶמַח דָּוִד עַבְדְּךָ מְהֵרָה תַצְמִיחַ, וְקַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, כִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּינוּ כָּל הַיּוֹם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה.
items.translation: Speedily cause the offshoot of David Your servant to flourish, and raise his standing through Your salvation, for we wait for Your salvation all day. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who causes the standing of salvation to flourish.
items.translit: ʾeth ṣemaḥ dawīdh 'avdĕkha mĕhera thaṣmiaḥ, wĕqarno tarum bishu'athekha, ki lishu'athĕkha qiwwinu kol hayyom. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, maṣmiaḥ qeren yĕshu'a.

items.hebrew: שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, אָב הָרַחֲמָן, רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, וְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ, כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלּוֹת וְתַחֲנוּנִים אָתָּה. וּמִלְּפָנֶיךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ, רֵיקָם אַל תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ, חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ. כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלַּת כָּל פֶּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה.
items.translation: Hear our voice, Adhonay our God, merciful Father; have compassion on us, and accept our prayer with mercy and favor, for You are a God who hears prayers and supplications. Do not turn us away empty-handed from before You, our King; be gracious to us, answer us, and hear our prayer, for You hear the prayer of every mouth. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who hears prayer.
items.translit: shĕma' qolenu, Adhonay ʾĕlohenu, ʾav haraḥăman, raḥem 'alenu, wĕqabbel bĕraḥămim uvĕraṣon ʾeth tĕfillathenu, ki ʾel shomea' tĕfilloth wĕthaḥănunim ʾatta. umillĕfanekha malkenu, reqam ʾal tĕshivenu, ḥannenu wa'ănenu ushĕma' tĕfillathenu. ki ʾatta shomea' tĕfillath kol peh. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shomea' tĕfilla.

items.hebrew: אומרים הביננו במקום שלש עשרה הברכות האמצעיות
items.translation: Havinenu is said in place of the middle thirteen blessings.

items.hebrew: הֲבִינֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָדַעַת דְּרָכֶיךָ, וּמוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵנוּ לְיִרְאָתֶךָ. [במוצאי שבת ויום טוב: לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל.] תִּסְלַח לָנוּ לִהְיוֹת גְּאוּלִים. וְרַחֲקֵנוּ מִמַּכְאוֹב, וְדַשְּׁנֵנוּ בִּנְאוֹת אַרְצֶךָ, [בימות הגשמים: וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר,] וּנְפוּצִים מֵאַרְבַּע תְּקַבֵּץ, וְהַתּוֹעִים בְּדַעְתְּךָ יִשָּׁפֵטוּ, וְעַל הָרְשָׁעִים תָּנִיף יָדֶךָ, וְיִשְׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בְּבִנְיַן עִירָךְ וּבְתִקּוּן הֵיכָלָךְ, וּבִצְמִיחַת קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדָּךְ, וּבַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחָךְ. טֶרֶם נִקְרָא וְאַתָּה תַעֲנֶה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה.
items.translation: Grant us understanding, Adhonay our God, to know Your ways, and circumcise our hearts to revere You. [At the close of Shabbat and festivals: to distinguish between the holy and the ordinary.] Forgive us so that we may be redeemed; keep us far from pain, and let us feast on the pastures of Your land, [In the rainy season: and grant dew and rain,] gather our scattered from the four corners of the earth, and let those who stray from Your knowledge be judged; raise Your hand against the wicked, and let the righteous rejoice in the building of Your city, the restoration of Your Sanctuary, the flourishing of an heir for David Your servant, and the setting of a light for the son of Yishai, Your anointed. Before we call, may You answer. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who hears prayer.
items.translit: hăvinenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu ladha'ath dĕrakhekha, umol ʾeth lĕvavenu lĕyirʾathekha. [vmwṣʾy shvth wywm ṭwv: lĕhavdil ben qodhesh lĕḥol.] tislaḥ lanu lihyoth gĕʾulim. wĕraḥăqenu mimmakhʾov, wĕdhashshĕnenu binʾoth ʾarṣekha, [vymwth hghshmym: wĕthen ṭal umaṭar,] unĕfuṣim meʾarba' tĕqabbeṣ, wĕhatto'im bĕdha'tĕkha yishshafeṭu, wĕ'al harĕsha'im tanif yadhekha, wĕyismĕḥu ṣaddiqim bĕvinyan 'irakh uvĕthiqqun hekhalakh, uviṣmiḥath qeren lĕdhawīdh 'avdakh, uva'ărikhath ner lĕven yishay mĕshiḥakh. ṭerem niqraʾ wĕʾatta tha'ăneh. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shomea' tĕfilla.

items.hebrew: רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵׁב הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם מְהֵרָה בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן, וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים תַּחְפֹּץ בָּנוּ וְתִרְצֵנוּ, וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.
items.translation: Be pleased, Adhonay our God, with Your people Israel, and attend to their prayer; restore the service to the inner sanctuary of Your house, and accept in love and favor, speedily, the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer; and may the service of Your people Israel always be favorable to You. And You, in Your abundant mercy, desire us and be pleased with us, and let our eyes see Your merciful return to Zion. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who restores His presence to Zion.
items.translit: rĕṣeh Adhonay ʾĕlohenu bĕ'ammĕkha yisraʾel wĕlithfillatham shĕ'eh, wĕhashev ha'ăvodha lidhvir bethekha, wĕʾishshe yisraʾel uthĕfillatham mĕhera bĕʾahăva thĕqabbel bĕraṣon, uthĕhi lĕraṣon tamidh 'ăvodhath yisraʾel 'ammekha. wĕʾatta bĕraḥămekha harabbim taḥpoṣ banu wĕthirṣenu, wĕtheḥĕzena 'enenu bĕshuvĕkha lĕṣiyyon bĕraḥămim. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, hammaḥăzir shĕkhinatho lĕṣiyyon.

items.hebrew: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שֶׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּרֵנוּ צוּר חַיֵּינוּ וּמָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא, לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, הַמְּרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ. וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמָם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא תָּמִיד שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וְכָל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ וִיבָרְכוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל בֶּאֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה, הָאֵל הַטּוֹב. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.
items.translation: We give thanks to You, that You are Adhonay our God and the God of our ancestors forever; You are the Rock of our lives, the Shield of our salvation, from generation to generation. We will thank You and recount Your praise for our lives that are entrusted into Your hand, for our souls that are in Your charge, for Your miracles that are with us every day, and for Your wonders and goodness at every hour — evening, morning, and noon. You are good, for Your mercies never end; You are compassionate, for Your kindnesses never cease — for we have always placed our hope in You. And for all these, may Your name, our King, be blessed and exalted and raised on high, always, forever. And let all the living give thanks to You, Selah, and praise and bless Your great name in truth, forever, for it is good — the God of our salvation and our help, Selah, the good God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, whose name is good, and to whom thanks are fitting.
items.translit: modhim ʾănaḥnu lakh, sheʾatta huʾ Adhonay ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu lĕ'olam wa'edh, ṣurenu ṣur ḥayyenu umaghen yish'enu ʾatta huʾ, lĕdhor wadhor nodheh lĕkha unĕsapper tĕhillathekha, 'al ḥayyenu hammĕsurim bĕyadhekha, wĕ'al nishmothenu happĕqudhoth lakh, wĕ'al nissekha shebbĕkhal yom 'immanu, wĕ'al niflĕʾothekha wĕṭovothekha shebbĕkhal 'eth, 'erev wavoqer wĕṣohŏrayīm. haṭṭov, ki loʾ khalu raḥămekha, hammĕraḥem, ki loʾ thammu ḥăsadhekha, ki me'olam qiwwinu lakh. wĕ'al kullam yithbarakh wĕyithromam wĕyithnasseʾ tamidh shimkha malkenu lĕ'olam wa'edh. wĕkhol haḥayyim yodhukha sela, wihalĕlu wivarĕkhu ʾeth shimkha haggadhol beʾĕmeth lĕ'olam ki ṭov, haʾel yĕshu'athenu wĕ'ezrathenu sela, haʾel haṭṭov. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, haṭṭov shimkha ulĕkha naʾeh lĕhodhoth.

items.hebrew: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. וּבָרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרָה וְחַיִּים, אַהֲבָה וָחֶסֶד, צְדָקָה וְרַחֲמִים, בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרְכֵנוּ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֶת כָּל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרֹב עֹז וְשָׁלוֹם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם. אָמֵן.
items.translation: Grant peace, goodness, and blessing, life, grace, kindness, and mercy, upon us and upon all Israel Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one, with the light of Your countenance; for by the light of Your countenance You have given us, Adhonay our God, Torah and life, love and kindness, righteousness and mercy, blessing and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless us, and to bless all Your people Israel, with abundant strength and peace. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who blesses His people Israel with peace. Amen.
items.translit: sim shalom ṭova uvĕrakha, ḥayyim ḥen waḥesedh wĕraḥămim, 'alenu wĕ'al kol yisraʾel 'ammekha. uvarĕkhenu ʾavinu kullanu kĕʾeḥadh bĕʾor panekha, ki vĕʾor panekha nathatta lanu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu tora wĕḥayyim, ʾahăva waḥesedh, ṣĕdhaqa wĕraḥămim, bĕrakha wĕshalom. wĕṭov bĕ'enekha lĕvarĕkhenu ulĕvarekh ʾeth kol 'ammĕkha yisraʾel bĕrov 'oz wĕshalom. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, hammĕvarekh ʾeth 'ammo yisraʾel bashshalom. ʾamen.

items.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי, נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וְשִׂפְתוֹתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדֹּם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְאַחֲרֵי מִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי. וְכָל הַקָּמִים עָלַי לְרָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחְשְׁבוֹתָם. יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְיָ דּוֹחֶה. קַבֵּל רִנַּת עַמֶּךָ, שַׂגְּבֵנוּ טַהֲרֵנוּ נוֹרָא. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמָךְ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינָךְ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתָךְ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתָךְ. יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי.
items.translation: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit; to those who curse me let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, and let my soul pursue Your commandments. As for all who plan evil against me, swiftly nullify their counsel and frustrate their plans. Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of Adhonay driving them on. Accept the song of Your people; raise us up and purify us, awesome One. Act for the sake of Your name, act for the sake of Your right hand, act for the sake of Your Torah, act for the sake of Your holiness. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Adhonay, my Rock and my Redeemer.
items.translit: ʾĕlohay, nĕṣor lĕshoni mera' wĕsifthothay middabber mirma, wĕlimqallay nafshi thiddom, wĕnafshi ke'afar lakkol tihyeh. pĕthaḥ libbi bĕthorathekha, wĕʾaḥăre miṣwothekha tirdof nafshi. wĕkhol haqqamim 'alay lĕra'a, mĕhera hafer 'ăṣatham wĕqalqel maḥshĕvotham. yihyu kĕmoṣ lifne ruaḥ umalʾakh Adhonay doḥeh. qabbel rinnath 'ammekha, saggĕvenu ṭahărenu noraʾ. 'ăseh lĕma'an shĕmakh, 'ăseh lĕma'an yĕminakh, 'ăseh lĕma'an torathakh, 'ăseh lĕma'an qĕdhushshathakh. yihyu lĕraṣon ʾimre fi wĕheghyon libbi lĕfanekha, Adhonay ṣuri wĕghoʾăli.

items.hebrew: יש אומרים תפלת רב מגמרא ברכות ט״ז ע״ב, שכתב החיד״א ז״ל בסידורו
items.translation: Some say the prayer of Rav, from the Talmud, Berakhot 16b, as recorded by the Chida in his siddur:

items.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּתֶּן לָנוּ חַיִּים אֲרֻכִּים, חַיִּים שֶׁל שָׁלוֹם, חַיִּים שֶׁל טוֹבָה, חַיִּים שֶׁל בְּרָכָה, חַיִּים שֶׁל פַּרְנָסָה, חַיִּים שֶׁל חִלּוּץ עֲצָמוֹת, חַיִּים שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהֶם יִרְאַת חֵטְא, חַיִּים שֶׁאֵין בָּהֶם בּוּשָׁה וּכְלִמָּה, חַיִּים שֶׁל עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד, חַיִּים שֶׁתְּהֵא בָנוּ אַהֲבַת תּוֹרָה וְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם, חַיִּים שֶׁתְּמַלֵּא אֶת כָּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹת לִבֵּנוּ לְטוֹבָה.
items.translation: May it be Your will, Adhonay our God and God of our ancestors, that You grant us long life — a life of peace, a life of good, a life of blessing, a life of sustenance, a life of bodily vigor, a life in which there is fear of sin, a life without shame or humiliation, a life of wealth and honor, a life in which we have love of Torah and fear of Heaven, a life in which You fulfill all the wishes of our hearts for good.
items.translit: yĕhi raṣon millĕfanekha, Adhonay ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, shettitten lanu ḥayyim ʾărukkim, ḥayyim shel shalom, ḥayyim shel ṭova, ḥayyim shel bĕrakha, ḥayyim shel parnasa, ḥayyim shel ḥilluṣ 'ăṣamoth, ḥayyim sheyyesh bahem yirʾath ḥeṭʾ, ḥayyim sheʾen bahem busha ukhĕlimma, ḥayyim shel 'osher wĕkhavodh, ḥayyim shettĕheʾ vanu ʾahăvath tora wĕyirʾath shamayīm, ḥayyim shettĕmalleʾ ʾeth kol mishʾăloth libbenu lĕṭova.

items.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא בְּרַחֲמָיו יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
items.translation: He who makes peace in His high places, may He in His mercy make peace for us and for all His people Israel; and say, Amen.
items.translit: 'oseh shalom bimromaw, huʾ bĕraḥămaw ya'ăseh shalom 'alenu wĕ'al kol 'ammo yisraʾel, wĕʾimru ʾamen.

items.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּבְנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְתוֹרָתָךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֵּי רְצוֹנָךְ וּלְעָבְדָךְ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם.
items.translation: May it be Your will, Adhonay our God and God of our ancestors, that the Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah, to perform the statutes of Your will and to serve You with a whole heart.
items.translit: yĕhi raṣon millĕfanekha, Adhonay ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, shettivneh beth hammiqdash bimhera vĕyamenu, wĕthen ḥelqenu vĕthorathakh la'ăsoth ḥuqqe rĕṣonakh ulĕ'avĕdhakh bĕlevav shalem.

items.hebrew: יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְיָ. רָם עַל כָּל גּוֹיִם יְיָ, עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ. יְיָ אֲדֹנֵינוּ, מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ.
items.translation: Blessed be the name of Adhonay from this time forth and forever. From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of Adhonay is praised. Adhonay is high above all nations; His glory is above the heavens. Adhonay, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth.
items.translit: yĕhi shem Adhonay mĕvorakh me'atta wĕ'adh 'olam. mimmizraḥ shemesh 'adh mĕvoʾo mĕhullal shem Adhonay. ram 'al kol goyīm Adhonay, 'al hashshamayīm kĕvodho. Adhonay ʾădhonenu, ma ʾaddir shimkha bĕkhol haʾareṣ.

items.hebrew: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת. אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל הֶהָרִים, מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי. עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְיָ, עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ. אַל יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ, אַל יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶךָ. הִנֵּה לֹא יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן, שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל. יְיָ שֹׁמְרֶךָ, יְיָ צִלְּךָ עַל יַד יְמִינֶךָ. יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹא יַכֶּכָּה, וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּיְלָה. יְיָ יִשְׁמָרְךָ מִכָּל רָע, יִשְׁמֹר אֶת נַפְשֶׁךָ. יְיָ יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ, מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם.
items.translation: A song of ascents. I lift my eyes to the mountains — from where will my help come? My help comes from Adhonay, Maker of heaven and earth. He will not let your foot slip; your guardian does not slumber. Behold, the guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps. Adhonay is your guardian; Adhonay is your shade at your right hand. The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night. Adhonay will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul. Adhonay will guard your going out and your coming in, from now and forever.
items.translit: shir lamma'ăloth. ʾessaʾ 'enay ʾel heharim, meʾayīn yavoʾ 'ezri. 'ezri me'īm Adhonay, 'oseh shamayīm waʾareṣ. ʾal yitten lammoṭ raghlekha, ʾal yanum shomĕrekha. hinneh loʾ yanum wĕloʾ yishan, shomer yisraʾel. Adhonay shomĕrekha, Adhonay ṣillĕkha 'al yadh yĕminekha. yomam hashshemesh loʾ yakkekka, wĕyareaḥ ballayĕla. Adhonay yishmarĕkha mikkol ra', yishmor ʾeth nafshekha. Adhonay yishmar ṣeʾthĕkha uvoʾekha, me'atta wĕ'adh 'olam.

items.hebrew: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל, לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת, וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה, שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם, שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהֶבֶל וָרִיק, וּמִתְפַּלְלִים אֶל אֵל לֹא יוֹשִׁיעַ. וַאֲנַחְנוּ מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְאֵין עוֹד אַחֵר, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ וְאֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת, אֵין עוֹד.
items.translation: It is our duty to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Author of creation, who has not made us like the nations of the lands nor placed us like the families of the earth; who has not made our portion like theirs, nor our destiny like all their multitude — for they bow to vapor and emptiness, and pray to a god who cannot save. But we bow before the King of kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He, who stretches out the heavens and lays the earth's foundations, whose seat of glory is in the heavens above and whose mighty presence is in the loftiest heights. He is our God; there is none else. He is our King in truth, and there is nothing beside Him — as it is written in His Torah: "You shall know this day and take it to heart, that Adhonay is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is none else."
items.translit: 'alenu lĕshabbeaḥ laʾădhon hakkol, latheth gĕdhulla lĕyoṣer bĕreʾshith, shelloʾ 'asanu kĕghoye haʾăraṣoth, wĕloʾ samanu kĕmishpĕḥoth haʾădhama, shelloʾ sam ḥelqenu kahem wĕghoralenu kĕkhal hămonam, shehem mishtaḥăwim lĕhevel wariq, umithpallim ʾel ʾel loʾ yoshia'. waʾănaḥnu mishtaḥăwim lifne melekh malkhe hammĕlakhim haqqadhosh barukh huʾ, shehuʾ noṭeh shamayīm wĕyosedh ʾareṣ, umoshav yĕqaro bashshamayīm mimma'al, ushĕkhinath 'uzzo bĕghovhe mĕromim. huʾ ʾĕlohenu, wĕʾen 'odh ʾaḥer, ʾĕmeth malkenu wĕʾefes zulatho, kakkathuv battora: wĕyadha'ta hayyom wahăshevotha ʾel lĕvavekha, ki Adhonay huʾ haʾĕlohim bashshamayīm mimma'al wĕ'al haʾareṣ mittaḥath, ʾen 'odh.
